activity.notes: Jean-Bédel Bokassa seized power in the 1 January 1966 coup and ruled the Central African Republic as president until 4 December 1976, when he replaced the republic with the Central African Empire and assumed the imperial title Bokassa I.

sources.title: Jean-Bédel Bokassa — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum records Bokassa as military ruler of the Central African Republic from 1 January 1966 and Emperor of the Central African Empire from 4 December 1976 until his overthrow on 20 September 1979.

sources.title: Jean-Bedel Bokassa, ruler of Central African Empire, crowns himself — South African History Online
sources.citation_text: South African History Online records Bokassa as head of state of the Central African Republic from 1 January 1966 to 4 December 1976, after which he declared the Central African Empire.
